_comment: Pre-existing raw .$transaction(...) calls using Serializable isolation, found when check-serializable-guard.mjs was introduced. NOT reviewed/confirmed as safe to wrap in runBookingTransaction (some may call non-idempotent code inside the callback, or may simply be outside this session's audited scope) - each is untouched technical debt, not an approved exception. This is a regression guard, not a retroactive one: it exists so no NEW unwrapped Serializable transaction is added silently, while not blocking the build on everything this session's audit did not touch. To remove an entry: confirm the callback is DB-only/idempotent, wrap it with runBookingTransaction, add a test, then delete the line here.
